.7 sasyakaḥ/tutthaḥ सस्यकः/तुत्थः
Bornite and peacock ore
Bornite and peacock ore have the chemical composition Cu3FeS4 and Cu5FeS4 respectively; copper sulfate is also known as tutthaḥ. In calcinated form tuttha is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.

ITA-5.76.232 tuttha-dagdhaḥ तुत्थ-दग्धः
Condition due to incomplete first-degree burn
A condition characterized by discoloration; burning sensation with sweating and restlessness; no blisters.
